worker:  count as inside `/srv/www` and `..foo` is allowed. Anything outside throws `EFORBIDDEN`.
- **Tests:** the original test is unchanged. The new ones cover the served cases, the forbidden cases (including the sibling-prefix one), the bad requests, and the drive-letter and UNC inputs. I also added a file-system-root test that checks a child path and `..foo`.

On Windows, the drive-letter and UNC inputs end up as ordinary names under the root. The test accepts either an error or a path inside the root for them.

My first attempt to write the files from a single shell command was denied, so I wrote them with the file tools. Git warned that LF will become CRLF on the next touch of these two files.

- **Original test:** `'a plain path is a file under the root'` at `resolve.test.js:6-9` matches the base commit `16b5126` text. Only the import line gained `sep`.
